name: is_canned
description: Indicates whether the product is canned, based on presence of the term 'canned' in either description. This is a strong signal for matching, as many beans in the block are canned, and it is a consistent format across both datasets.

name: is_dried
description: Indicates whether the product is from dried beans, as specified in the description. This is a key processing method that distinguishes dried from canned/frozen beans and is present in a notable subset of records.

name: bean_type
description: A single categorical attribute that captures the specific type of bean (e.g., kidney, pinto, green, black, lima, soy, chickpea), derived from the most salient terms in the product name or description. This replaces multiple boolean attributes to satisfy conditional independence and avoid redundancy. The categories are grounded in observed terms from the block's samples and candidate_terms, with careful alignment to both datasets' real-world usage.
